status: DESIGN DEVELOPMENT — supplier evidence only; product selection and purchasing held
scope: Japan-origin suppliers and documented Japan/Vietnam/regional channels; no claim every product is made in Japan.

project_basis.quantity_note: Model assemblies/items, not a purchase BOM; no equipment/route/register changes.

summary_criteria: Use manufacturer documentation and manufacturer-named local/regional channels; distinguish reseller listing from authorized warranty.
Gate each selected SKU on actual supply/frequency and maximum nameplate current/inrush; a 100V domestic product is not automatically usable.
Lighting: obtain exact optics/driver/accessory IES or LDT, dimming/flicker and replacement data.
Sound: obtain exact-model directivity/GLL, DSP/zone settings and microphones; separate speaker-line rating from mains demand.
Air: obey all-hidden central-view brief; duty-point curves/noise and maintainable duct/grille/support design precede selection.
Distribution/controls: preserve DB-1/DB-2 logic and offline manual operation; establish fault/earthing/protection and restart behavior.
Compare installed cost, commissioning, written warranty, spare lead times and local repair over an agreed service-life horizon; no invented score or best supplier.

suppliers.name: ENDO Lighting

product_classes.text: Architectural spots, downlights, outdoor lighting and compatible control ranges; cited examples are evidence, not substitutes.

voltage_status.text: International example GSTSA0900WA-WH27: AC220–240V; SXS3032S: AC100–242V. Check chosen SKU/frequency/driver.

documentation.text: Official product search/DIALux route; sample pages list IES, dimensions, specification and installation manuals. No photometry imported here.

channel_support.text: Japan international division and ENDO Lighting Vietnam sales subsidiary are manufacturer-listed.

compatibility_gaps: ACCORD55 cited example is non-dimmable; it cannot inherit scene dimming.
Exact optics, accessory photometry, glare, outdoor supports and Vietnam service terms pending.

suppliers.name: TOA

compatibility_gaps: Manufacturer data must replace proxy directivity; amplifier/DSP/zone topology and microphone feedback remain held.
Verify exact transformer taps, brackets, local commissioning and service terms.

suppliers.name: Audio-Technica

product_classes.text: ES925 installed gooseneck microphones; exact capsule, length and base are separate selections.

voltage_status.text: ES925C/XLR example: 11–52V DC phantom power; mains applies at the mixer/PSU, not at the capsule.

documentation.text: Official microphone manuals describe electrical requirements; exact polar/response data and variant must be obtained.

compatibility_gaps: 5-pin and XLR variants differ; confirm connector, phantom source and LED/control wiring.
Verify supplier authority for selected SKU, wind/noise isolation and actual gain-before-feedback.
